   198	
   199	class ThingsReader:
   200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
   201	
   202	    def __init__(
   203	        self,
   204	        api: ThingsAPI,
   205	        database_path: Path,
   206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
   207	        attempts: int = 3,
   208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
   209	    ) -> None:
   210	        self.api = api
   211	        self.database_path = database_path
   212	        self.sleep = sleep
   213	        self.attempts = attempts
   214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
   215	
   216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
   217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
   218	            try:
   219	                return self._read_once()
   220	            except Exception:
   221	                logger.exception(
   222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
   223	                    attempt,
   224	                    self.attempts,
   225	                )
   226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
   227	                    raise
   228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
   229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
   230	
   231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
   232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
   233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
   234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
   235	            rows = _rows(
   236	                self.api.todos(
   237	                    status=status,
   238	                    trashed=False,
   239	                    context_trashed=False,
   240	                    include_items=True,
   241	                    filepath=filepath,
   242	                )
   243	            )
   244	            for row in rows:
   245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
   246	                    continue
   247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
   248	                if not uuid:
   249	                    continue
   250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
   251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
   252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
   253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
   254	
   255	        projects = []
   256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
   257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
   258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
   259	
   260	        areas = []
   261	        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
   262	            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
   263	                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))
   264	
   265	        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
   266	        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))
   267	
   268	        return ThingsSnapshot(
   269	            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
   270	            projects=tuple(projects),
   271	            areas=tuple(areas),
   272	            today_uuids=today_uuids,
   273	            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
   274	        )

+++ b/src/markdown.py
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
+
+import re
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
+
+_STATUS_MARKERS = {
+    "incomplete": " ",
+    "completed": "x",
+    "canceled": "-",
+}
+_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
+
+
+def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
+    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
+    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
+    escaped = []
+    for character in normalized:
+        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
+            escaped.append("\\")
+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER
diff --git a/tests/test_markdown.py b/tests/test_markdown.py
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_markdown.py
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+from src.markdown import GENERATED_MARKER, render_document, render_task
+from src.models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+
+def test_render_task_includes_supported_metadata_and_omits_missing_fields():
+    task = TaskSnapshot(
+        uuid="TASK-1",
+        title="Release [v1]",
+        status="incomplete",
+        project_title="Product",
+        area_title="Work",
+        heading_title="Next",
+        notes="first line\n- nested-looking line",
+        tags=("important tag", "work"),
+        checklist=(
+            ChecklistItem(uuid="ITEM-1", title="Review *copy*", status="completed"),
+        ),
+        created="2026-09-04 09:00",
+        modified="2026-09-04 10:00",
+        deadline="2026-09-10",
+    )
+
+    rendered = render_task(task)
+
+    assert rendered.startswith("## [ ] Release \\[v1\\]\n<!-- uuid: TASK-1 -->")
+    assert "- **项目**: Product" in rendered
+    assert "- **截止日期**: 2026-09-10" in rendered
+    assert "- **开始日期**" not in rendered
+    assert "优先级" not in rendered
+    assert "Evening" not in rendered
+    assert "  first line\n  - nested-looking line" in rendered
+    assert "  - [x] Review \\*copy\\* <!-- uuid: ITEM-1 -->" in rendered
+
+
+def test_status_markers_are_stable():
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("1", "open", "incomplete")).startswith("## [ ]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("2", "done", "completed")).startswith("## [x]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("3", "no", "canceled")).startswith("## [-]")
+
+
+def test_document_has_marker_title_and_stable_separator():
+    task = TaskSnapshot("TASK-1", "one", "incomplete")
+
+    rendered = render_document("Inbox", [task])
+
+    assert rendered.startswith(f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Inbox\n\n")
+    assert rendered.endswith("\n---\n")
+
+
+def test_empty_document_remains_managed_and_deterministic():
+    assert render_document("Today", []) == f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Today\n"
```

140	1. `.env` 配置文件格式（通过 `.env.example` 了解）
141	2. `things.py` 库的 API 文档（Task, Project, Area 对象结构）
142	3. 现有 Markdown 文件的格式约定（UUID 注释位置）
143	4. Git 仓库的当前状态（避免破坏现有提交）
144	
145	### Coding Constraints
146	
147	#### 严格禁止
148	- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
149	- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
150	- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
151	- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
152	- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）
153	
154	#### 必须遵守
155	- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
156	- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
157	- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
158	- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
159	- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出
160	
161	#### Error Handling Standard
162	```python
163	import logging
164	import subprocess
165	from pathlib import Path
166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False
191	```

```markdown
# AGENTS.md - Things3 to GitHub Markdown Sync Agent

## Project Overview & Architecture

### Core Mission
自动监听 Things3 数据库变化，实时将任务数据转换为结构化 Markdown 文件，并通过 Git 同步到 GitHub 仓库，保持任务管理数据的版本化备份与可读性。

### Key Business Entities
- **Task（任务）**: Things3 核心实体，包含标题、状态、元数据、子任务
- **Project（项目）**: 任务容器，有独立文件夹结构
- **Area（领域）**: 更高层级的任务分组
- **Tag（标签）**: 跨项目的任务分类标记

### Core Data Flow
```
Things3 SQLite DB 
  ↓ (watchdog 监听文件变化)
things.py 库解析
  ↓ (数据模型转换)
Markdown Generator (增量更新策略)
  ↓ (文件系统写入)
Git Operations (auto commit & push)
  ↓
GitHub Repository (远程备份)
```

### Architecture Principles
- **事件驱动**: 文件监听 + 信号处理
- **增量优先**: 精确定位修改，减少 Git diff 噪音
- **容错设计**: 重试机制 + 日志追踪 + 全量校验兜底
- **零人工干预**: 后台服务 + 自动初始化

### Naming Conventions
- **文件名清理**: 非法字符 (`/`, `:`, `?`, `*`, `<`, `>`, `|`, `"`) 替换为 `-`
- **UUID 注释**: 每个任务/子任务包含隐藏的 `<!-- uuid: xxx -->` 用于增量定位
- **状态标记**: `[ ]` 未完成, `[x]` 已完成, `[-]` 已取消

## Codex Operational Rules

### Pre-execution Checklist
在修改任何核心逻辑前，必须先读取并理解：
1. `.env` 配置文件格式（通过 `.env.example` 了解）
2. `things.py` 库的 API 文档（Task, Project, Area 对象结构）
3. 现有 Markdown 文件的格式约定（UUID 注释位置）
4. Git 仓库的当前状态（避免破坏现有提交）

### Coding Constraints

#### 严格禁止
- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）

#### 必须遵守
- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出

#### Error Handling Standard
```python
import logging
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
    """
    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
  
    Returns:
        bool: 操作是否成功
    """
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            command,
            cwd=repo_path,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
            check=True
        )
        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
        return True
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
        return False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
        return False
```

- `tests/test_markdown_generator.py`: 测试 UUID 注释插入、任务章节定位
- `tests/test_parser.py`: 验证 Things3 数据解析的边界情况（空任务、特殊字符）
- `tests/test_git_ops.py`: Mock Git 命令，测试提交信息生成逻辑

#### Integration Test Scenarios
1. 创建任务 → 验证 Markdown 生成 → 检查 Git commit
2. 修改任务标题 → 验证仅该行被修改（Git diff 精确）
3. 移动任务（Inbox → Project）→ 验证旧文件删除 + 新文件创建
4. 删除 Project → 验证文件夹移动到 `Archived/`

## Configuration Specification

### .env File Format
```bash
# GitHub 仓库本地路径（已 clone 并配置认证）
REPO_PATH=/Users/username/Documents/things-backup

# 日志配置
LOG_LEVEL=INFO  # DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR
LOG_MAX_BYTES=10485760  # 10MB
LOG_BACKUP_COUNT=5

# 监听配置
WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS=2  # 防抖延迟（可选，默认立即提交）

# 全量校验间隔（秒）
FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL=3600  # 每小时一次
```

### .env.example Template
```bash
REPO_PATH=/path/to/your/github/repo
LOG_LEVEL=INFO
LOG_MAX_BYTES=10485760
LOG_BACKUP_COUNT=5
FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL=3600
```

## Codex Execution Guidelines

### Workflow for Each Task
1. **Read Context**: 查看相关现有代码和配置
2. **Implement**: 编写功能代码，遵循命名与错误处理规范
3. **Add Logging**: 为关键操作添加日志记录
4. **Write Tests**: 编写对应的单元测试
5. **Verify**: 运行测试，检查日志输出
6. **Update Checklist**: 标记任务为 `[x]` 完成

### When Blocked
- 如果 `things.py` API 不清晰 → 先编写测试脚本探索其行为
- 如果 Git 操作失败 → 检查仓库状态，记录详细错误信息
- 如果 Markdown 解析复杂 → 先实现简化版（全量重写），后续优化增量更新

### Safety Checks Before Each Commit
- [ ] 没有硬编码路径或凭证
- [ ] 所有异常都被捕获并记录
- [ ] Git 操作有超时保护
- [ ] 测试通过（如果有）

项目被视为成功，当：
1. ✅ 在 Things3 中创建任务后 2 秒内，GitHub 仓库出现对应 Markdown

3. ✅ 程序连续运行 7 天无崩溃，日志无 ERROR 级别记录
4. ✅ 全量校验能在 30 秒内完成（1000 任务规模）
5. ✅ launchd 服务开机自启动，无需人工干预

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
+
+import re
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
+
+_STATUS_MARKERS = {
+    "incomplete": " ",
+    "completed": "x",
+    "canceled": "-",
+}
+_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
+
+
+def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
+    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
+    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
+    escaped = []
+    for character in normalized:
+        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
+            escaped.append("\\")
+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

+from src.markdown import GENERATED_MARKER, render_document, render_task
+from src.models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+
+def test_render_task_includes_supported_metadata_and_omits_missing_fields():
+    task = TaskSnapshot(
+        uuid="TASK-1",
+        title="Release [v1]",
+        status="incomplete",
+        project_title="Product",
+        area_title="Work",
+        heading_title="Next",
+        notes="first line\n- nested-looking line",
+        tags=("important tag", "work"),
+        checklist=(
+            ChecklistItem(uuid="ITEM-1", title="Review *copy*", status="completed"),
+        ),
+        created="2026-09-04 09:00",
+        modified="2026-09-04 10:00",
+        deadline="2026-09-10",
+    )
+
+    rendered = render_task(task)
+
+    assert rendered.startswith("## [ ] Release \\[v1\\]\n<!-- uuid: TASK-1 -->")
+    assert "- **项目**: Product" in rendered
+    assert "- **截止日期**: 2026-09-10" in rendered
+    assert "- **开始日期**" not in rendered
+    assert "优先级" not in rendered
+    assert "Evening" not in rendered
+    assert "  first line\n  - nested-looking line" in rendered
+    assert "  - [x] Review \\*copy\\* <!-- uuid: ITEM-1 -->" in rendered
+
+
+def test_status_markers_are_stable():
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("1", "open", "incomplete")).startswith("## [ ]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("2", "done", "completed")).startswith("## [x]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("3", "no", "canceled")).startswith("## [-]")
+
+
+def test_document_has_marker_title_and_stable_separator():
+    task = TaskSnapshot("TASK-1", "one", "incomplete")
+
+    rendered = render_document("Inbox", [task])
+
+    assert rendered.startswith(f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Inbox\n\n")
+    assert rendered.endswith("\n---\n")
+
+
+def test_empty_document_remains_managed_and_deterministic():
+    assert render_document("Today", []) == f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Today\n"

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Literal, Mapping, Optional, Tuple

TaskStatus = Literal["incomplete", "completed", "canceled"]
ContainerKind = Literal["project", "area"]
ChangeKind = Literal["added", "modified", "deleted"]
_VALID_STATUSES = {"incomplete", "completed", "canceled"}

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChecklistItem:
    uuid: str
    title: str
    status: TaskStatus
    stop_date: Optional[str] = None
    created: Optional[str] = None
    modified: Optional[str] = None
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.status not in _VALID_STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported checklist status: {self.status}")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TaskSnapshot:
    uuid: str
    title: str
    status: TaskStatus
    task_type: str = "to-do"
    start: Optional[str] = None
    area_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    area_title: Optional[str] = None
    project_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    project_title: Optional[str] = None
    heading_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    heading_title: Optional[str] = None
    notes: Optional[str] = None
    tags: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    checklist: Tuple[ChecklistItem, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    start_date: Optional[str] = None
    deadline: Optional[str] = None
    reminder_time: Optional[str] = None
    stop_date: Optional[str] = None
    created: Optional[str] = None
    modified: Optional[str] = None
    index: int = 0
    today_index: int = 0
    trashed: bool = False
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.status not in _VALID_STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported task status: {self.status}")
        if self.task_type != "to-do":
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported task type: {self.task_type}")
        object.__setattr__(self, "tags", tuple(self.tags))
        object.__setattr__(self, "checklist", tuple(self.checklist))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ContainerSnapshot:
    uuid: str
    kind: ContainerKind
    title: str
    area_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    area_title: Optional[str] = None
    index: int = 0
    trashed: bool = False

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ThingsSnapshot:
    tasks: Tuple[TaskSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    projects: Tuple[ContainerSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    areas: Tuple[ContainerSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    today_uuids: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    upcoming_uuids: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("tasks", "projects", "areas", "today_uuids", "upcoming_uuids"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, tuple(getattr(self, name)))
        task_ids = [task.uuid for task in self.tasks]
        container_ids = [c.uuid for c in self.projects + self.areas]
        if len(task_ids) != len(set(task_ids)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate task UUID in snapshot")
        if len(container_ids) != len(set(container_ids)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate container UUID in snapshot")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ContainerPath:
    uuid: str
    kind: ContainerKind
    relative_dir: Path

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RenderedSnapshot:
    files: Mapping[Path, str]
    containers: Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "files", MappingProxyType(dict(self.files)))
        object.__setattr__(self, "containers", tuple(self.containers))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChangeSet:
    added: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    modified: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    deleted: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    git_paths: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    @property
    def paths(self) -> Tuple[Path, ...]:
        return tuple(sorted(set(self.added + self.modified + self.deleted)))
    @property
    def changed(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.paths)
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("added", "modified", "deleted"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, tuple(sorted(set(getattr(self, name)))))
        object.__setattr__(self, "git_paths", tuple(sorted(set(self.git_paths))))
        if not self.git_paths and self.paths:
            object.__setattr__(self, "git_paths", self.paths)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SyncResult:
    changes: ChangeSet
    committed: bool = False
    pushed: bool = False
"""Read-only adapter for snapshots from the Things Python API."""

import logging
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Protocol, Tuple, cast

from .models import ChecklistItem, ContainerSnapshot, TaskSnapshot, ThingsSnapshot

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ThingsAPI(Protocol):
    def todos(self, **kwargs: object) -> object:
        ...

    def projects(self, **kwargs: object) -> object:
        ...

    def areas(self, **kwargs: object) -> object:
        ...

    def today(self, **kwargs: object) -> object:
        ...

    def upcoming(self, **kwargs: object) -> object:
        ...


MODERN_PATTERN = Path("Library/Group Containers/JLMPQHK86H.com.culturedcode.ThingsMac")
OLD_RELATIVE = MODERN_PATTERN / "Things Database.thingsdatabase/main.sqlite"


def load_default_api() -> ThingsAPI:
    """Load and validate the module-level read-only Things API."""
    import things

    required = ("todos", "projects", "areas", "today", "upcoming")
    missing = [name for name in required if not callable(getattr(things, name, None))]
    if missing:
        raise AttributeError(
            "Things API is missing callable(s): " + ", ".join(missing)
        )
    return cast(ThingsAPI, things)


def discover_database_path(
    explicit: Optional[Path] = None, home: Optional[Path] = None
) -> Path:
    """Find the Things database, preferring an explicitly supplied path."""
    if explicit is not None:
        candidate = explicit.expanduser().resolve()
        if not candidate.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Things database not found: {candidate}")
        return candidate

    home_path = home or Path.home()
    root = home_path / MODERN_PATTERN
    modern = sorted(
        root.glob("ThingsData-*/Things Database.thingsdatabase/main.sqlite")
    )
    if modern:
        return modern[-1].resolve()

    old = (home_path / OLD_RELATIVE).resolve()
    if old.is_file():
        return old
    raise FileNotFoundError("Things database was not found in known locations")


def _text(value: object, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return a text value while preserving missing/None optional fields."""
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    return str(value)


def _integer(value: object, default: int = 0) -> int:
    """Return an integer value, using a deterministic default when absent."""
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value)
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _normalize_checklist(items: object) -> Tuple[ChecklistItem, ...]:
    """Normalize checklist dictionaries and provide stable ordering."""
    if not isinstance(items, (list, tuple)):
        return ()

    normalized: List[ChecklistItem] = []
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        uuid = _text(item.get("uuid"), "") or ""
        status = _text(item.get("status"), "incomplete") or "incomplete"
        title = _text(item.get("title"), "") or ""
        normalized.append(
            ChecklistItem(
                uuid=uuid,
                title=title,
                status=cast(str, status),
                stop_date=_text(item.get("stop_date")),
                created=_text(item.get("created")),
                modified=_text(item.get("modified")),
            )
        )
    normalized.sort(key=lambda item: (item.created or "", item.uuid))
    return tuple(normalized)


def _normalize_task(row: Dict[str, object]) -> TaskSnapshot:
    """Normalize one Things to-do dictionary into a domain snapshot."""
    status = _text(row.get("status"), "incomplete") or "incomplete"
    tags_value = row.get("tags")
    tags: List[str] = []
    if isinstance(tags_value, (list, tuple, set)):
        tags = [text for text in (_text(tag) for tag in tags_value) if text is not None]
    tags.sort()

    return TaskSnapshot(
        uuid=_text(row.get("uuid"), "") or "",
        title=_text(row.get("title"), "") or "",
        status=cast(str, status),
        task_type=_text(row.get("type"), "to-do") or "to-do",
        start=_text(row.get("start")),
        area_uuid=_text(row.get("area")),
        area_title=_text(row.get("area_title")),
        project_uuid=_text(row.get("project")),
        project_title=_text(row.get("project_title")),
        heading_uuid=_text(row.get("heading")),
        heading_title=_text(row.get("heading_title")),
        notes=_text(row.get("notes")),
        tags=tuple(tags),
        checklist=_normalize_checklist(row.get("checklist")),
        start_date=_text(row.get("start_date")),
        deadline=_text(row.get("deadline")),
        reminder_time=_text(row.get("reminder_time")),
        stop_date=_text(row.get("stop_date")),
        created=_text(row.get("created")),
        modified=_text(row.get("modified")),
        index=_integer(row.get("index")),
        today_index=_integer(row.get("today_index")),
        trashed=bool(row.get("trashed", False)),
    )


def _normalize_project(row: Dict[str, object]) -> ContainerSnapshot:
    """Normalize one Things project dictionary."""
    return ContainerSnapshot(
        uuid=_text(row.get("uuid"), "") or "",
        kind="project",
        title=_text(row.get("title"), "") or "",
        area_uuid=_text(row.get("area")),
        area_title=_text(row.get("area_title")),
        index=_integer(row.get("index")),
        trashed=bool(row.get("trashed", False)),
    )


def _normalize_area(row: Dict[str, object]) -> ContainerSnapshot:
    """Normalize one Things area dictionary."""
    return ContainerSnapshot(
        uuid=_text(row.get("uuid"), "") or "",
        kind="area",
        title=_text(row.get("title"), "") or "",
        index=_integer(row.get("index")),
        trashed=bool(row.get("trashed", False)),
    )


def _rows(value: object) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
    """Keep only dictionary rows returned by the external API."""
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return []
    return [row for row in value if isinstance(row, dict)]


def _dynamic_uuids(value: object) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
    """Extract ordered, unique, non-trashed to-do UUIDs."""
    result: List[str] = []
    seen = set()
    for row in _rows(value):
        if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
            continue
        uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
        if uuid and uuid not in seen:
            seen.add(uuid)
            result.append(uuid)
    return tuple(result)


class ThingsReader:
    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        api: ThingsAPI,
        database_path: Path,
        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
        attempts: int = 3,
        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.api = api
        self.database_path = database_path
        self.sleep = sleep
        self.attempts = attempts
        self.retry_delay = retry_delay

    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
            try:
                return self._read_once()
            except Exception:
                logger.exception(
                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
                    attempt,
                    self.attempts,
                )
                if attempt == self.attempts:
                    raise
                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")

    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
        filepath = str(self.database_path)
        tasks_by_uuid = {}
        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
            rows = _rows(
                self.api.todos(
                    status=status,
                    trashed=False,
                    context_trashed=False,
                    include_items=True,
                    filepath=filepath,
                )
            )
            for row in rows:
                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
                    continue
                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
                if not uuid:
                    continue
                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
                if previous is not None and previous != row:
                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row

        projects = []
        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))

        areas = []
        for row in _rows(self.api.areas(filepath=filepath)):
            if row.get("type") == "area" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
                areas.append(_normalize_area(row))

        today_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.today(filepath=filepath))
        upcoming_uuids = _dynamic_uuids(self.api.upcoming(filepath=filepath))

        return ThingsSnapshot(
            tasks=tuple(_normalize_task(row) for row in tasks_by_uuid.values()),
            projects=tuple(projects),
            areas=tuple(areas),
            today_uuids=today_uuids,
            upcoming_uuids=upcoming_uuids,
        )
```

```
1	# Things3 到 GitHub Markdown 同步 MVP 设计
2	
3	## 背景
4	
5	本项目需要在 macOS 上只读监听 Things3 数据库，将任务导出为结构化 Markdown，并通过 Git 自动提交和推送到用户已配置的远端仓库。
6	
7	仓库中的 `Agent.md` 描述了完整产品愿景，但当前主项目尚无实现。内嵌的 `things.py` 1.0.1 参考库公开的是返回稀疏字典的函数接口，而不是 `Task`、`Project`、`Area` 类；它也不提供优先级、Evening 等字段。因此 MVP 以参考库的真实只读数据为准，不输出无法可靠获得的字段。
8	
9	## 目标
10	
11	MVP 必须做到：
12	
13	1. 启动时读取完整 Things3 快照并同步 Markdown。
14	2. 监听 Things3 SQLite 数据库及其 WAL/SHM 变化，经防抖后再次同步。
15	3. 使用确定性渲染和原子文件替换，使内容未变化时不写磁盘、不产生 Git diff。
16	4. 自动暂存同步器实际变更的明确路径，按配置提交并推送。
17	5. 定时运行同一套完整快照同步，修复遗漏或漂移。
18	6. 捕获 `SIGINT` 和 `SIGTERM`，停止接收新工作并等待当前同步结束。
19	7. 提供安装、配置、前台运行与 launchd 部署文档和自动化测试。
20	
21	## 非目标
22	
23	MVP 不包括：
24	
25	- 从 Markdown 写回 Things3。
26	- Things 附件同步。
27	- 自动 merge、rebase 或解决 Git 冲突。
28	- 从底层数据库私有字段推导 `things.py` 未公开的优先级、Evening 或重复规则。
29	- Web 管理界面和性能监控面板。
30	- 对真实 GitHub 远端或真实用户 Things 数据库执行自动化集成测试。
31	
32	## 关键决策
33	
34	### 同步策略
35	
36	采用“防抖后的确定性完整快照”策略，而不是在 MVP 中维护独立的增量写入路径。
37	
38	每次同步均执行：
39	
40	```text
41	读取完整只读快照
42	  -> 规范化数据
43	  -> 渲染期望文件集合
44	  -> 原子协调磁盘
45	  -> 明确暂存变更路径
46	  -> 可选提交
47	  -> 可选推送
48	```
49	
50	SQLite 文件变化事件无法直接指出发生变化的任务。即使做 UUID 级增量更新，也必须先读取新快照做差异比较。完整快照渲染可同时正确处理任务移动、删除、容器重命名和 Today/Upcoming 派生视图，并让启动同步、监听同步和定时校验复用同一条代码路径。
51	
52	完整快照不意味着无条件重写文件。文件协调器先比较字节内容，只替换发生变化的文件。由此，单个标题变化通常只产生对应标题行的 Git diff。
53	
54	### 文件所有权
55	
56	同步器完全管理它生成的 Markdown 内容，但删除操作采用保守边界：
57	
58	- 每个生成文件包含稳定的生成标识。
59	- 仅删除位于已知导出路径中、带生成标识且不再属于期望快照的文件。
60	- 未带生成标识的陌生文件始终保留并记录警告。
61	- 同步器不使用笼统的目录递归删除处理未知内容。
62	
63	该规则兼顾确定性全量协调和用户文件保护。
64	
65	### 主位置与派生视图
66	
67	每个任务只有一个主位置，优先级如下：
68	
69	1. 所属 Project。
70	2. 所属 Area。
71	3. `Inbox`、`Anytime` 或 `Someday` 顶层列表。
72	
73	`Today.md` 和 `Upcoming.md` 是派生视图，允许重复展示已有主位置的任务。Today 的语义直接复用 `things.today()`，不根据单一 `start` 字段自行重建。
74	
75	## 架构
76	
77	### `src/config.py`
78	
79	负责读取和验证 `.env` 配置，向其他模块提供类型化配置对象。配置包括：
80	
81	- `REPO_PATH`：目标 Git 仓库绝对路径。
82	- `THINGSDB`：可选数据库覆盖路径；缺省时使用 `things.py` 自带的路径发现。
83	- `LOG_LEVEL`、`LOG_MAX_BYTES`、`LOG_BACKUP_COUNT`。
84	- `WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS`。
85	- `FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL`。
86	- `AUTO_COMMIT`、`AUTO_PUSH`。
87	- `GIT_REMOTE`、`GIT_BRANCH`。
88	- Git 子进程超时。
89	
90	约束：`AUTO_PUSH=true` 时必须启用 `AUTO_COMMIT`。目标路径必须存在且为 Git 工作树。敏感配置不写入日志。
91	
92	### `src/models.py`
93	
94	定义项目内部不可变数据模型，将外部稀疏字典与渲染逻辑隔离。主要实体为：
95	
96	- `TaskSnapshot`
97	- `ChecklistItem`
98	- `ContainerSnapshot`
99	- `ThingsSnapshot`
100	
101	可选字段有明确的 `None` 或空集合默认值。状态只接受 `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled`；类型只接受 MVP 用到的 `to-do`、`project`、`heading`。
102	
103	### `src/things_adapter.py`
104	
105	只使用 `things` 的读取接口：`tasks()`、`areas()`、`today()`、`upcoming()` 等，并把结果规范化为内部模型。
106	
107	该模块不导入或调用 `complete()`，也不构造 `update`/`update-project` URL。数据库访问失败后等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次。只有读取并规范化完整快照成功后才向调用方返回结果。
108	
109	数据库定位遵循：
110	
111	1. 显式 `THINGSDB`。
112	2. `things.py` 对现代 `ThingsData-*` 路径的发现。
113	3. 参考库的旧路径回退。
114	
115	### `src/renderer.py`
116	
117	输入一个 `ThingsSnapshot`，输出 `dict[Path, str]`，键是相对于目标仓库的安全路径，值是确定性 UTF-8 Markdown 内容。
118	
119	职责包括：
120	
121	- 分配任务主位置和终态文件。
122	- 构造 Today/Upcoming 派生视图。
123	- 对任务进行稳定排序。
124	- 渲染任务区块、UUID 注释、元数据和 checklist。
125	- 清理文件名并解决路径冲突。
126	- 转义会破坏 Markdown 结构的单行内容。
127	
128	该模块不读取或写入文件，也不执行 Git。
129	
130	### `src/filesystem.py`
131	
132	协调期望文件集合与目标仓库当前状态：
133	
134	- 内容相同的文件不写入。
135	- 新内容先写入目标文件同目录下的临时文件，刷新后使用 `os.replace()` 原子替换。
136	- 删除不再存在的旧托管文件。
137	- 保留所有陌生文件。
138	- 返回新增、修改、删除的明确相对路径集合，供 Git 层使用。
139	
140	一次同步先完成快照读取和全部内容渲染，再开始修改目标仓库，避免数据库读取失败造成部分输出。
141	
142	### `src/git_ops.py`
143	
144	通过 `subprocess.run()` 封装 Git 命令，统一捕获 stdout、stderr 和超时。所有命令都设置工作目录和超时。
145	
146	行为规则：
147	
148	- 只执行 `git add -- <明确路径列表>`，不使用 `git add .`。
149	- 删除路径同样通过明确 pathspec 暂存。
150	- 仅当暂存区含同步器产生的差异时提交。
151	- 提交消息格式为：`Update: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | Added N, Modified N, Deleted N`。
152	- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 时执行 `git push <remote> <branch>`。
153	- 不自动 pull、merge 或 rebase。
154	- Git 失败时保留已落盘内容及本地提交，记录可操作的错误信息，等待下一次同步重试。
155	- 不暂存或修改仓库中其他未提交内容。
156	
157	### `src/sync_engine.py`
158	
159	协调一次同步，并使用互斥锁保证进程内最多只有一个同步执行：
160	
161	1. 获取完整 Things 快照。
162	2. 渲染期望文件。
163	3. 协调文件系统。
164	4. 无变化时结束。
165	5. 按配置提交和推送。
166	6. 记录耗时、文件数量和结果。
167	
168	启动同步、监听事件和定时校验均调用此入口。
169	
170	### `src/watcher.py`
171	
172	使用 `watchdog` 监听实际数据库文件所在目录，关注：
173	
174	- `main.sqlite`
175	- `main.sqlite-wal`
176	- `main.sqlite-shm`
177	
178	相关事件在配置的防抖窗口内合并为一次同步请求。事件处理线程不直接执行同步，而把请求交给串行协调逻辑。新事件若发生在同步期间，会在当前同步结束后至多补跑一次，避免丢失最终状态或形成无限并发。
179	
180	### `main.py`
181	
182	应用入口负责：
183	
184	1. 加载配置和初始化轮转日志。
185	2. 注册 `SIGINT`、`SIGTERM`。
186	3. 创建同步引擎并执行启动同步。
187	4. 启动文件监听与定时完整同步。
188	5. 退出时停止接收新请求，关闭监听和定时器，等待当前 Git 操作在既定超时内结束。
189	
190	## 输出结构
191	
192	```text
193	<REPO_PATH>/
194	├── Inbox.md
195	├── Today.md
196	├── Anytime.md
197	├── Someday.md
198	├── Upcoming.md
199	├── 已完成.md
200	├── 已取消.md
201	├── Projects/
202	│   └── <项目名>/
203	│       ├── tasks.md
204	│       ├── 已完成.md
205	│       └── 已取消.md
206	├── Areas/
207	│   └── <领域名>/
208	│       ├── tasks.md
209	│       ├── 已完成.md
210	│       └── 已取消.md
211	└── Archived/
212	    ├── Projects/
213	    └── Areas/
214	```
215	
216	空的固定顶层视图仍生成，以保持结构稳定。空 Project/Area 是否保留由当前快照中容器是否存在决定：存在的空容器保留目录和空的托管文件；消失或进入回收站的容器导出目录移入对应 `Archived` 子目录。
217	
218	由于 `things.py` 的 Area API 不提供可靠的回收站状态，Area 从快照消失只表示导出侧不再可见，不声称它在 Things 中具有特定“归档”状态。
219	
220	## 路径规则
221	
222	文件名清理遵循以下规则：
223	
224	- 将 `/`、`:`、`?`、`*`、`<`、`>`、`|`、`"` 和控制字符替换为 `-`。
225	- 去除首尾空白和结尾句点。
226	- 空名称使用实体类型加 UUID 短前缀。
227	- 限制单个路径段长度，为 `.md` 和冲突后缀预留空间。
228	- 两个名称清理后相同，或在默认不区分大小写的 macOS 文件系统上发生大小写冲突时，为所有冲突项追加稳定 UUID 短后缀。
229	
230	路径分配只依赖实体 UUID 和标题，同一快照的结果始终一致。
231	
232	## Markdown 合同
233	
234	每个文件第一行使用固定生成标识，随后是标题和任务区块。任务区块示例：
235	
236	```markdown
237	## [ ] 任务标题
238	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
239	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
240	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
241	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
242	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
243	- **提醒时间**: 09:00
244	- **项目**: 项目 A
245	- **领域**: 工作
246	- **标题分组**: 下一步
247	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
248	- **备注**:
249	  任务的详细描述内容
250	- **子任务**:
251	  - [ ] 子任务 1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
252	  - [x] 子任务 2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
253	
254	---
255	```
256	
257	规则：
258	
259	- `incomplete`、`completed`、`canceled` 分别映射为 `[ ]`、`[x]`、`[-]`。
260	- 缺失的可选字段整行省略，不输出空占位。
261	- 不输出参考库没有公开提供的优先级和 Evening 字段。
262	- 标题和单行字段转义换行及结构性 Markdown 字符。
263	- Notes 保留多行文本，统一换行符并缩进，使其保持在备注字段下。
264	- Checklist 项包含 UUID 和状态；可用时保留完成时间。
265	- UUID 是区块稳定身份，不从标题或路径推导。
266	- 文件和任务使用稳定排序，避免无业务变化的重新排列。
267	
268	## 容器移动与归档
269	
270	文件协调前，渲染器根据当前快照产生当前 Project/Area 路径映射。协调器还读取上一轮生成清单，以 UUID 识别容器重命名、消失和重新出现：
271	
272	- 重命名：将托管内容写入新路径，删除旧路径下的托管文件；陌生文件留在原目录并告警。
273	- 消失或进入回收站：将仅含托管文件的导出目录移到 `Archived/Projects` 或 `Archived/Areas`；若含陌生文件，不移动整个目录，只归档托管文件并保留陌生内容。
274	- 重新出现：从当前快照生成到活动路径；不会自动搬回用户添加的陌生文件。
275	
276	`Archived/` 是持久历史区，不属于“当前期望文件集合”的删除范围。已归档的托管文件会保留到用户显式清理；若同一容器 UUID 后续再次归档，则更新该 UUID 对应的归档位置，而不是创建无限重复副本。活动路径永远只反映当前快照。
277	
278	同步器维护一个带生成标识的清单文件，记录活动容器映射、归档容器 UUID、相对路径和托管文件集合。该清单属于同步器管理范围，并参与明确路径 Git 暂存。
279	
280	## 错误处理
281	
282	### 数据库读取
283	
284	- 最多尝试 3 次。
285	- 每次失败后等待 10 秒，再进行下一次尝试。
286	- 最终失败时，不进入文件协调和 Git 阶段。
287	- 记录异常类别和上下文，但不记录 token 或完整敏感路径配置。
288	
289	### 文件系统
290	
291	- 单文件写入使用同目录临时文件和原子替换。
292	- 临时文件失败时清理自身，不删除原文件。
293	- 某个文件协调失败会终止该轮 Git 操作，并记录已经成功落盘的路径；下一轮通过确定性快照收敛。
294	
295	### Git
296	
297	- 所有子进程有超时。
298	- 非零退出记录 stderr。
299	- 提交失败时不推送。
300	- 推送失败时保留本地提交。
301	- 远端领先或认证错误不触发自动冲突处理。
302	
303	## 配置与部署
304	
305	项目提供：
306	
307	- `.env.example`
308	- `requirements.txt`
309	- `setup.py` 交互式配置脚本
310	- `generate_launchd.py`
311	- `main.py`
312	- README 安装和运维说明
313	
314	依赖基线：
315	
316	- Python 3.9+
317	- `things.py>=1.0.1,<2`
318	- `watchdog>=2.1,<7`
319	- `python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`
320	
321	launchd 生成器在项目内生成 plist 预览。用户通过明确的 setup 步骤安装到 `~/Library/LaunchAgents`，普通同步进程不修改系统 launchd 配置。
322	
323	## 测试策略
324	
325	### 单元测试
326	
327	`tests/test_things_adapter.py`：
328	
329	- 使用内嵌参考库的 SQLite fixture 或等价测试数据库，通过 `THINGSDB` 注入。
330	- 验证稀疏字典规范化、状态映射、空字段、Project/Area/Heading 关系。
331	- 验证失败重试次数和间隔，不真实等待 10 秒。
332	- 验证适配器只调用读取 API。
333	
334	`tests/test_renderer.py`：
335	
336	- 顶层、Project、Area 主位置优先级。
337	- Today/Upcoming 派生重复展示。
338	- 完成和取消文件。
339	- Markdown 特殊字符、多行 Notes、Checklist 状态。
340	- 路径清理、空标题、重名和大小写冲突。
341	- 稳定排序和确定性输出。
342	
343	`tests/test_filesystem.py`：
344	
345	- 无变化不写入。
346	- 新增、原子修改、删除旧托管文件。
347	- 保留陌生文件。
348	- 容器重命名、归档及含陌生文件时的保守行为。
349	- 中途失败后下一轮收敛。
350

+"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
+
+import re
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
+
+_STATUS_MARKERS = {
+    "incomplete": " ",
+    "completed": "x",
+    "canceled": "-",
+}
+_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
+
+
+def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
+    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
+    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
+    escaped = []
+    for character in normalized:
+        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
+            escaped.append("\\")
+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

+from src.markdown import GENERATED_MARKER, render_document, render_task
+from src.models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+
+def test_render_task_includes_supported_metadata_and_omits_missing_fields():
+    task = TaskSnapshot(
+        uuid="TASK-1",
+        title="Release [v1]",
+        status="incomplete",
+        project_title="Product",
+        area_title="Work",
+        heading_title="Next",
+        notes="first line\n- nested-looking line",
+        tags=("important tag", "work"),
+        checklist=(
+            ChecklistItem(uuid="ITEM-1", title="Review *copy*", status="completed"),
+        ),
+        created="2026-09-04 09:00",
+        modified="2026-09-04 10:00",
+        deadline="2026-09-10",
+    )
+
+    rendered = render_task(task)
+
+    assert rendered.startswith("## [ ] Release \\[v1\\]\n<!-- uuid: TASK-1 -->")
+    assert "- **项目**: Product" in rendered
+    assert "- **截止日期**: 2026-09-10" in rendered
+    assert "- **开始日期**" not in rendered
+    assert "优先级" not in rendered
+    assert "Evening" not in rendered
+    assert "  first line\n  - nested-looking line" in rendered
+    assert "  - [x] Review \\*copy\\* <!-- uuid: ITEM-1 -->" in rendered
+
+
+def test_status_markers_are_stable():
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("1", "open", "incomplete")).startswith("## [ ]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("2", "done", "completed")).startswith("## [x]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("3", "no", "canceled")).startswith("## [-]")
+
+
+def test_document_has_marker_title_and_stable_separator():
+    task = TaskSnapshot("TASK-1", "one", "incomplete")
+
+    rendered = render_document("Inbox", [task])
+
+    assert rendered.startswith(f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Inbox\n\n")
+    assert rendered.endswith("\n---\n")
+
+
+def test_empty_document_remains_managed_and_deterministic():
+    assert render_document("Today", []) == f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Today\n"

+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER
```

+"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
+
+import re
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
+
+_STATUS_MARKERS = {
+    "incomplete": " ",
+    "completed": "x",
+    "canceled": "-",
+}
+_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
+
+
+def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
+    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
+    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
+    escaped = []
+    for character in normalized:
+        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
+            escaped.append("\\")
+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

+from src.markdown import GENERATED_MARKER, render_document, render_task
+from src.models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+
+def test_render_task_includes_supported_metadata_and_omits_missing_fields():
+    task = TaskSnapshot(
+        uuid="TASK-1",
+        title="Release [v1]",
+        status="incomplete",
+        project_title="Product",
+        area_title="Work",
+        heading_title="Next",
+        notes="first line\n- nested-looking line",
+        tags=("important tag", "work"),
+        checklist=(
+            ChecklistItem(uuid="ITEM-1", title="Review *copy*", status="completed"),
+        ),
+        created="2026-09-04 09:00",
+        modified="2026-09-04 10:00",
+        deadline="2026-09-10",
+    )
+
+    rendered = render_task(task)
+
+    assert rendered.startswith("## [ ] Release \\[v1\\]\n<!-- uuid: TASK-1 -->")
+    assert "- **项目**: Product" in rendered
+    assert "- **截止日期**: 2026-09-10" in rendered
+    assert "- **开始日期**" not in rendered
+    assert "优先级" not in rendered
+    assert "Evening" not in rendered
+    assert "  first line\n  - nested-looking line" in rendered
+    assert "  - [x] Review \\*copy\\* <!-- uuid: ITEM-1 -->" in rendered
+
+
+def test_status_markers_are_stable():
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("1", "open", "incomplete")).startswith("## [ ]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("2", "done", "completed")).startswith("## [x]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("3", "no", "canceled")).startswith("## [-]")
+
+
+def test_document_has_marker_title_and_stable_separator():
+    task = TaskSnapshot("TASK-1", "one", "incomplete")
+
+    rendered = render_document("Inbox", [task])
+
+    assert rendered.startswith(f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Inbox\n\n")
+    assert rendered.endswith("\n---\n")
+
+
+def test_empty_document_remains_managed_and_deterministic():
+    assert render_document("Today", []) == f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Today\n"

+# Things3 到 GitHub Markdown 同步 MVP Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
+
+**Goal:** 构建一个 macOS 后台服务，只读监听 Things3 数据库，把完整任务快照确定性导出为 Markdown，并按配置自动提交和推送到 Git 仓库。
+
+**Architecture:** 所有触发源都调用同一条快照流水线：只读适配器规范化 Things 字典，纯渲染器生成期望文件和容器映射，文件协调器原子收敛磁盘状态，Git 层只暂存明确路径。服务层用防抖队列串行化数据库事件、启动同步和定时同步，并在信号退出时等待当前操作结束。
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.9+、`things.py>=1.0.1,<2`、`watchdog>=2.1,<7`、`python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`、标准库 `dataclasses`/`pathlib`/`sqlite3`/`subprocess`/`threading`/`logging`、pytest。
+
+## Global Constraints
+
+- 运行平台为 macOS，Python 最低版本为 3.9。
+- 运行时依赖必须限定为 `things.py>=1.0.1,<2`、`watchdog>=2.1,<7`、`python-dotenv>=0.19,<2`；测试依赖在 `requirements-dev.txt` 中声明。
+- Things 数据库只能通过读取接口访问；业务代码不得导入或调用 `complete()`，不得构造 `update` 或 `update-project` URL。
+- 所有文件路径使用 `pathlib.Path`；所有 Git 命令使用带超时的 `subprocess.run()`。
+- 数据库读取失败后间隔 10 秒重试，最多 3 次；完整快照成功前不得修改目标仓库。
+- 禁止使用 `git add .`；只暂存文件协调器返回的明确相对路径。
+- 同步器只删除带生成标识的已知托管文件；陌生文件必须保留并记录警告。
+- `AUTO_PUSH=true` 必须同时满足 `AUTO_COMMIT=true`。
+- 不自动 pull、merge、rebase 或解决远端冲突。
+- 输出中不包含参考库未公开的优先级、Evening、附件或重复规则字段。
...

136	## Codex Operational Rules
137	
138	### Pre-execution Checklist
139	在修改任何核心逻辑前，必须先读取并理解：
140	1. `.env` 配置文件格式（通过 `.env.example` 了解）
141	2. `things.py` 库的 API 文档（Task, Project, Area 对象结构）
142	3. 现有 Markdown 文件的格式约定（UUID 注释位置）
143	4. Git 仓库的当前状态（避免破坏现有提交）
144	
145	### Coding Constraints
146	
147	#### 严格禁止
148	- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
149	- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
150	- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
151	- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
152	- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）
153	
154	#### 必须遵守
155	- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
156	- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
157	- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
158	- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
159	- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出
160	
161	#### Error Handling Standard
162	```python
163	import logging
164	import subprocess
165	from pathlib import Path
166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False
191	```

193	### Testing & Verification
194	
195	#### Unit Test Requirements
196	- `tests/test_markdown_generator.py`: 测试 UUID 注释插入、任务章节定位
197	- `tests/test_parser.py`: 验证 Things3 数据解析的边界情况（空任务、特殊字符）
198	- `tests/test_git_ops.py`: Mock Git 命令，测试提交信息生成逻辑
199	
200	#### Integration Test Scenarios
201	1. 创建任务 → 验证 Markdown 生成 → 检查 Git commit
202	2. 修改任务标题 → 验证仅该行被修改（Git diff 精确）
203	3. 移动任务（Inbox → Project）→ 验证旧文件删除 + 新文件创建
204	4. 删除 Project → 验证文件夹移动到 `Archived/`

274	LOG_BACKUP_COUNT=5

276	# 监听配置

280	FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL=3600  # 每小时一次

   179	    """Keep only dictionary rows returned by the external API."""
   180	    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
   181	        return []
   182	    return [row for row in value if isinstance(row, dict)]
   183	
   184	
   185	def _dynamic_uuids(value: object) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
   186	    """Extract ordered, unique, non-trashed to-do UUIDs."""
   187	    result: List[str] = []
   188	    seen = set()
   189	    for row in _rows(value):
   190	        if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
   191	            continue
   192	        uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
   193	        if uuid and uuid not in seen:
   194	            seen.add(uuid)
   195	            result.append(uuid)
   196	    return tuple(result)

   199	class ThingsReader:
   200	    """Read a complete, immutable Things snapshot without mutation APIs."""
   201	
   202	    def __init__(
   203	        self,
   204	        api: ThingsAPI,
   205	        database_path: Path,
   206	        sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
   207	        attempts: int = 3,
   208	        retry_delay: float = 10.0,
   209	    ) -> None:
   210	        self.api = api
   211	        self.database_path = database_path
   212	        self.sleep = sleep
   213	        self.attempts = attempts
   214	        self.retry_delay = retry_delay
   215	
   216	    def read_snapshot(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
   217	        for attempt in range(1, self.attempts + 1):
   218	            try:
   219	                return self._read_once()
   220	            except Exception:
   221	                logger.exception(
   222	                    "Things snapshot read failed on attempt %s/%s",
   223	                    attempt,
   224	                    self.attempts,
   225	                )
   226	                if attempt == self.attempts:
   227	                    raise
   228	                self.sleep(self.retry_delay)
   229	        raise AssertionError("unreachable")
   230	
   231	    def _read_once(self) -> ThingsSnapshot:
   232	        filepath = str(self.database_path)
   233	        tasks_by_uuid = {}
   234	        for status in ("incomplete", "completed", "canceled"):
   235	            rows = _rows(
   236	                self.api.todos(
   237	                    status=status,
   238	                    trashed=False,
   239	                    context_trashed=False,
   240	                    include_items=True,
   241	                    filepath=filepath,
   242	                )
   243	            )
   244	            for row in rows:
   245	                if row.get("type") != "to-do" or bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
   246	                    continue
   247	                uuid = _text(row.get("uuid"))
   248	                if not uuid:
   249	                    continue
   250	                previous = tasks_by_uuid.get(uuid)
   251	                if previous is not None and previous != row:
   252	                    logger.warning("Conflicting Things payloads for task %s", uuid)
   253	                tasks_by_uuid[uuid] = row
   254	
   255	        projects = []
   256	        for row in _rows(self.api.projects(trashed=False, filepath=filepath)):
   257	            if row.get("type") == "project" and not bool(row.get("trashed", False)):
   258	                projects.append(_normalize_project(row))
   259	
   260	        areas = []

+"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
+
+import re
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
+
+_STATUS_MARKERS = {
+    "incomplete": " ",
+    "completed": "x",
+    "canceled": "-",
+}
+_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
+
+
+def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
+    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
+    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
+    escaped = []
+    for character in normalized:
+        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
+            escaped.append("\\")
+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

+from src.markdown import GENERATED_MARKER, render_document, render_task
+from src.models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+
+def test_render_task_includes_supported_metadata_and_omits_missing_fields():
+    task = TaskSnapshot(
+        uuid="TASK-1",
+        title="Release [v1]",
+        status="incomplete",
+        project_title="Product",
+        area_title="Work",
+        heading_title="Next",
+        notes="first line\n- nested-looking line",
+        tags=("important tag", "work"),
+        checklist=(
+            ChecklistItem(uuid="ITEM-1", title="Review *copy*", status="completed"),
+        ),
+        created="2026-09-04 09:00",
+        modified="2026-09-04 10:00",
+        deadline="2026-09-10",
+    )
+
+    rendered = render_task(task)
+
+    assert rendered.startswith("## [ ] Release \\[v1\\]\n<!-- uuid: TASK-1 -->")
+    assert "- **项目**: Product" in rendered
+    assert "- **截止日期**: 2026-09-10" in rendered
+    assert "- **开始日期**" not in rendered
+    assert "优先级" not in rendered
+    assert "Evening" not in rendered
+    assert "  first line\n  - nested-looking line" in rendered
+    assert "  - [x] Review \\*copy\\* <!-- uuid: ITEM-1 -->" in rendered
+
+
+def test_status_markers_are_stable():
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("1", "open", "incomplete")).startswith("## [ ]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("2", "done", "completed")).startswith("## [x]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("3", "no", "canceled")).startswith("## [-]")
+
+
+def test_document_has_marker_title_and_stable_separator():
+    task = TaskSnapshot("TASK-1", "one", "incomplete")
+
+    rendered = render_document("Inbox", [task])
+
+    assert rendered.startswith(f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Inbox\n\n")
+    assert rendered.endswith("\n---\n")
+
+
+def test_empty_document_remains_managed_and_deterministic():
+    assert render_document("Today", []) == f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Today\n"

11	- **Project（项目）**: 任务容器，有独立文件夹结构
12	- **Area（领域）**: 更高层级的任务分组
13	- **Tag（标签）**: 跨项目的任务分类标记
14	
15	### Core Data Flow
16	```
17	Things3 SQLite DB 
18	  ↓ (watchdog 监听文件变化)
19	things.py 库解析
20	  ↓ (数据模型转换)
21	Markdown Generator (增量更新策略)
22	  ↓ (文件系统写入)
23	Git Operations (auto commit & push)
24	  ↓
25	GitHub Repository (远程备份)
26	```
27	
28	### Architecture Principles
29	- **事件驱动**: 文件监听 + 信号处理
30	- **增量优先**: 精确定位修改，减少 Git diff 噪音
31	- **容错设计**: 重试机制 + 日志追踪 + 全量校验兜底
32	- **零人工干预**: 后台服务 + 自动初始化
33

136	## Codex Operational Rules
137	
138	### Pre-execution Checklist
139	在修改任何核心逻辑前，必须先读取并理解：
140	1. `.env` 配置文件格式（通过 `.env.example` 了解）
141	2. `things.py` 库的 API 文档（Task, Project, Area 对象结构）
142	3. 现有 Markdown 文件的格式约定（UUID 注释位置）
143	4. Git 仓库的当前状态（避免破坏现有提交）
144	
145	### Coding Constraints
146	
147	#### 严格禁止
148	- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
149	- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
150	- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
151	- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
152	- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）
153	
154	#### 必须遵守
155	- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
156	- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
157	- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
158	- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
159	- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出
160	
161	#### Error Handling Standard
162	```python
163	import logging
164	import subprocess
165	from pathlib import Path
166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False
191	```

109	### Markdown Format Standard
110	```markdown
111	## [ ] 任务标题
112	<!-- uuid: ABC123DEF456 -->
113	- **创建时间**: 2025-01-15 10:30
114	- **修改时间**: 2025-01-15 14:20
115	- **开始日期**: 2025-01-16
116	- **截止日期**: 2025-01-20
117	- **标签**: #工作 #重要
118	- **优先级**: High
119	- **特殊字段**: Evening
120	- **备注**: 
121	  任务的详细描述内容，支持多行
122	- **子任务**:
123	  - [ ] 子任务1 <!-- uuid: SUB123 -->
124	  - [x] 子任务2 <!-- uuid: SUB456 -->
125	
126	---
127	```
128	
129	### Naming Conventions
130	- **文件名清理**: 非法字符 (`/`, `:`, `?`, `*`, `<`, `>`, `|`, `"`) 替换为 `-`
131	- **UUID 注释**: 每个任务/子任务包含隐藏的 `<!-- uuid: xxx -->` 用于增量定位
132	- **状态标记**: `[ ]` 未完成, `[x]` 已完成, `[-]` 已取消

135	
136	## Codex Operational Rules
137	
138	### Pre-execution Checklist
139	在修改任何核心逻辑前，必须先读取并理解：
140	1. `.env` 配置文件格式（通过 `.env.example` 了解）
141	2. `things.py` 库的 API 文档（Task, Project, Area 对象结构）
142	3. 现有 Markdown 文件的格式约定（UUID 注释位置）
143	4. Git 仓库的当前状态（避免破坏现有提交）
144	
145	### Coding Constraints
146	
147	#### 严格禁止
148	- ❌ 直接修改 Things3 数据库（只读访问）
149	- ❌ 在 Markdown 中硬编码文件路径或用户信息
150	- ❌ 使用 `git add .`（必须明确指定文件）
151	- ❌ 引入未在 `requirements.txt` 声明的第三方库
152	- ❌ 阻塞式等待（所有 I/O 操作需配置超时）
153	
154	#### 必须遵守
155	- ✅ 所有文件操作使用 `pathlib.Path`
156	- ✅ Git 命令通过 `subprocess.run()` 执行，捕获 stderr
157	- ✅ 数据库读取失败时，等待 10 秒重试，最多 3 次
158	- ✅ 每个函数配置日志记录（使用 `logging` 模块）
159	- ✅ 信号处理：捕获 `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` 优雅退出
160	
161	#### Error Handling Standard
162	```python
163	import logging
164	import subprocess
165	from pathlib import Path
166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False
191	```
192	
193	### Testing & Verification
194	
195	#### Unit Test Requirements
196	- `tests/test_markdown_generator.py`: 测试 UUID 注释插入、任务章节定位
197	- `tests/test_parser.py`: 验证 Things3 数据解析的边界情况（空任务、特殊字符）
198	- `tests/test_git_ops.py`: Mock Git 命令，测试提交信息生成逻辑
199	
200	#### Integration Test Scenarios
201	1. 创建任务 → 验证 Markdown 生成 → 检查 Git commit
202	2. 修改任务标题 → 验证仅该行被修改（Git diff 精确）
203	3. 移动任务（Inbox → Project）→ 验证旧文件删除 + 新文件创建
204	4. 删除 Project → 验证文件夹移动到 `Archived/`

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
+
+import re
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
+
+_STATUS_MARKERS = {
+    "incomplete": " ",
+    "completed": "x",
+    "canceled": "-",
+}
+_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
+
+
+def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
+    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
+    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
+    escaped = []
+    for character in normalized:
+        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
+            escaped.append("\\")
+        escaped.append(character)
+    return "".join(escaped)
+
+
+def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
+    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
+
+
+def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
+    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
+
+
+def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    rendered = []
+    for tag in tags:
+        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
+        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
+    return " ".join(rendered)
+
+
+def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
+    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
+    lines = normalized.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
+        lines.pop()
+    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
+        return ()
+    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
+
+
+def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
+    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
+    if item.stop_date:
+        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
+    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
+
+
+def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
+    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
+    lines = [
+        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
+        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
+    ]
+
+    fields = (
+        ("创建时间", task.created),
+        ("修改时间", task.modified),
+        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
+        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
+        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
+        ("项目", task.project_title),
+        ("领域", task.area_title),
+        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
+    )
+    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
+
+    if task.tags:
+        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
+
+    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
+    if note_lines:
+        lines.append("- **备注**:")
+        lines.extend(note_lines)
+
+    if task.checklist:
+        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
+        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
+    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
+    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
+    if not tasks:
+        return header
+
+    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
+    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
+
+
+def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
+    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
+    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

+from src.markdown import GENERATED_MARKER, render_document, render_task
+from src.models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
+
+
+def test_render_task_includes_supported_metadata_and_omits_missing_fields():
+    task = TaskSnapshot(
+        uuid="TASK-1",
+        title="Release [v1]",
+        status="incomplete",
+        project_title="Product",
+        area_title="Work",
+        heading_title="Next",
+        notes="first line\n- nested-looking line",
+        tags=("important tag", "work"),
+        checklist=(
+            ChecklistItem(uuid="ITEM-1", title="Review *copy*", status="completed"),
+        ),
+        created="2026-09-04 09:00",
+        modified="2026-09-04 10:00",
+        deadline="2026-09-10",
+    )
+
+    rendered = render_task(task)
+
+    assert rendered.startswith("## [ ] Release \\[v1\\]\n<!-- uuid: TASK-1 -->")
+    assert "- **项目**: Product" in rendered
+    assert "- **截止日期**: 2026-09-10" in rendered
+    assert "- **开始日期**" not in rendered
+    assert "优先级" not in rendered
+    assert "Evening" not in rendered
+    assert "  first line\n  - nested-looking line" in rendered
+    assert "  - [x] Review \\*copy\\* <!-- uuid: ITEM-1 -->" in rendered
+
+
+def test_status_markers_are_stable():
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("1", "open", "incomplete")).startswith("## [ ]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("2", "done", "completed")).startswith("## [x]")
+    assert render_task(TaskSnapshot("3", "no", "canceled")).startswith("## [-]")
+
+
+def test_document_has_marker_title_and_stable_separator():
+    task = TaskSnapshot("TASK-1", "one", "incomplete")
+
+    rendered = render_document("Inbox", [task])
+
+    assert rendered.startswith(f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Inbox\n\n")
+    assert rendered.endswith("\n---\n")
+
+
+def test_empty_document_remains_managed_and_deterministic():
+    assert render_document("Today", []) == f"{GENERATED_MARKER}\n# Today\n"
